builderChecks: Zone: every part and subPart, with rotation applied, stays within Z 23-30.6 and X 0-40. No exceptions in this replica.

Eyes: EXACTLY two lit windows (EyeWindow_Left_Flat, EyeWindow_Right_4Pane). No other front window exists or glows — there are NO ground-floor front windows in this replica (the porch/mouth occupies the whole ground band).
Asymmetry: left eye flat in wall + cross muntins + arch trim; right eye 2x2 four-pane in the projecting dormer box. If the two eyes match, it is wrong.
Eye level: both eye centres at Y 7.6. The dormer projects forward (front face Z 25.3 vs wall face Z 27), NOT up.
Brow: EaveBeam_CentreDip must sit approx 0.45 lower than the end segments, and the skirt must have NO shards between X 18.6 and 21.4 (broken centre).
Teeth colour: every tooth uses a grey-blue siding-family colour. Any white/cream tooth fails the build.
Teeth lengths: upper teeth lengths are 1.35/0.75/1.2/0.5/1.4/0.85/1.15/0.6/1.0 — uneven on purpose. Do not tidy them.
Default state: monster layer ON, rest layer OFF. DoorGlow_Plane and DoorLight_Pool must be hidden at spawn.
Chimney: small, at X 18.6 (just LEFT of centre), with SmokeWisp. If it reads as a major feature, shrink it.
No arms, no legs, no extra front windows, no side wings, no garage, no casino colours on the house.

coordinateSystem.axes: X = east, Z = north, Y = up. Floor top Y = 0.
coordinateSystem.facing: House front faces SOUTH toward the playable yard and spawn (20, 0, 3). Main wall front plane at Z = 27.
coordinateSystem.grid: World footprint X 0-40, Z 0-30. Facade zone Z 23-30. Positions are part CENTERS; rotationDeg is Euler XYZ degrees applied to the part.
coordinateSystem.zoneRule: Every part (including subParts, rotation accounted) must stay at Z >= 23 and Z <= 30.6. This replica needs NO yard exceptions: even the porch steps land at Z = 23.3.

defaultState: MONSTER MODE: house planted, mouth OPEN (monster layer visible), door light OFF (rest layer hidden). No tree-limb arms, no legs. Rest layer parts exist for a possible at-rest toggle but ship hidden.

palette.ambient: Deep blue-teal night #0B1D2A-#14313F (scene lighting, set by the lighting/pipeline section; recorded here so the facade materials match).
palette.forbidden: No casino palette on the facade — no neon, no gold trim (REFERENCE palette check). Casino dressing lives in the yard only.
palette.siding: #54646E range (mid blue-grey), weathering darker at board ends
palette.teeth: Grey-blue splintered timber from the siding family (#54646E / #4A5A63 / #5E707A). NEVER white, never cream, never even.
palette.trees: Near-black blue-grey #1E2A30 with pale rim light

ratios.H: Total height H = 21 units (ground to ridge approx 21.3). H/W = 1.05 — inside the REFERENCE band 1.0-1.1.
ratios.W: House body width W = 20 units (body X 10-30, centre X = 20). All REFERENCE ratios are fractions of W measured from the body's west edge (X = 10).
ratios.bands: Porch band Y 0-5 (approx 24% of H); upper wall band Y 5-9.5 (approx 21%); shingle-skirt/brow transition Y 9.5-12.6 (approx 15%); roof mass Y 12.3-21.3 (approx 40%+ — slab base overlaps the skirt top).
ratios.eyes: Centres X 17 (= 0.35 W) and X 23 (= 0.65 W); spacing 6 = 0.30 W (band 0.30-0.35). Each 2.0 wide = 0.10 W (band 0.09-0.11), 2.4 tall (taller than wide), same level Y centre 7.6 (ruling 5).
ratios.mouth: Width 17 = 0.85 W; height 3.5 (porch interior Y 0.6-4.1). Upper teeth longest 1.4 = 40% of mouth height; lower teeth max 1.05 = 30%.
ratios.trees: Framing trunks at X 6.8 and 33.2 = +/-0.66 W from centre (band 0.6-0.7); trunk width 1.6 = 0.08 W (band 0.07-0.09).
